response.overview: A pregnant girl hangs by the neck. Monstrosities slake their lust on the living, the dead, and the headless. Carnal denizens of the abyss wreak their perversion upon the lascivious and the chaste. All this and more dare to unlock a stygian cryptogram of ghastly occult science that strives to prolapse our ideals into a morbid netherscape where the beautiful and the revolting, the arousing and the hideous, and the lovely and the abominable are all one in the same.  You will never be the same once you have encountered… THE WALKING WOMAN
response.tagline: You will never be the same once you have encountered… THE WALKING WOMAN
response.title: The Walking Woman
